retrievalProfile.description: A close-up male portrait featuring a distinctive torn-paper color block in the upper corner with fluid, handwritten script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man with a mustache, positioned on the right, set against a blurred urban background. The top-left corner is defined by a jagged, torn-edge red shape that serves as a backdrop for white, fluid, hand-drawn script lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Torn paper edge creates diagonal tension
Script typography follows the angle of the torn edge
Warm skin tones contrasted against cool blue background tones
coreInvariants: Jagged, irregular 'torn' edge separating the color block from the photo

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright red torn-paper corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red corner/text, follows the torn edge down, and settles on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blurred background to the left of the subject provides breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral beige and tan (clothing and skin)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red accent; low to medium saturation in the photographic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight mimicking a brush or marker
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters integrated into the flow of lowercase
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for all text elements.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the informal, marker-like quality of the original.
Provides the necessary weight and flow.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium close-up portrait of a man with a mustache in 80s attire, positioned on the right. The background should be a soft-focus urban setting with blue and grey tones. In the top-left corner, include a solid red shape with a jagged, white 'torn paper' edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-lettered white script text over the red corner and the adjacent background, following the diagonal flow of the torn edge.

verificationChecks: Is the torn edge sufficiently irregular?
Does the script feel organic and handwritten?
Is the subject's gaze engaging the viewer?
Is the red corner the primary color accent?

adjustableVariables: Color of the torn paper corner
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible despite the script style
Ensure the torn edge looks like physical paper, not a digital zig-zag
Verify the color balance between the red accent and the muted portrait
Confirm the subject is correctly positioned to the right
Ensure the script has variable line weight
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Torn Corner Accent + Fluid Script Overlay
